evidence: Independently authored source-informed goal-sensitive cheap transport/record prefab control; not a fresh play, optimum, or goal-insensitive proof. Prior authored route structure was read; no control function imported.

finalGoals.title: A supported first survey
finalGoals.requirement: Earn a real beacon observation with the actual initially blank survey-camera at survey-window, through one local rigid clear watertight surface enclosing that camera’s own lens and plate. This first service may later move.

conditions.label: actual survey camera observed beacon through its rigid clear boundary

finalGoals.title: A soft form doing real work
finalGoals.requirement: The actual original working-clay material matches filter-pad’s profile, fits while moldable, and actively supplies its outgoing water route to the growing nursery at garden. The displayed outlet supplies water only through an actively seated exposed porous matching surface; hand water remains available for wetting clay. This is an operating temporary filter, not a fit demonstration; it may later be fired and repurposed.

conditions.label: original soft fitted material actively supplies water
the original soft filter actively feeds the original nursery

finalGoals.title: Keep the living station working

conditions.label: same original nursery grows within its local clear rigid boundary

finalGoals.title: Diffuse light for a second growing service
finalGoals.requirement: A growing rootbed at shade-bed has one actual diffuse watertight boundary actively enclosing the lit growing tray and seed. A separate decorative diffuser does not count.

conditions.label: local diffuse growing boundary

finalGoals.title: Daylight redirected into the shade
finalGoals.requirement: An exposed supported reflector at mirror-perch supplies an active light interface to shade-bed in both rows, where the bed grows. Flexible foil with support or a rigid reflector is valid.
